description: Summarise the detector benchmark as a figure and place bll6423 in the distribution, then write the artifact tables: evidence matrix and GO decision table.
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
df = pd.read_csv("detector_benchmark_cupin_pdb.csv")
n_hit = int(df.detector_hit.sum()); n_tot = len(df)
print(f"{n_hit}/{n_tot} = {100*n_hit/n_tot:.1f}% of experimentally determined cupin chains "
      f"show a >=3-residue ligand cluster")
print("distribution of cluster size:\n", df.detector_n.value_counts().sort_index().to_string())

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15.5, 4.4))

a = ax[0]
bins = np.arange(-0.5, df.detector_n.max()+1.5)
a.hist([df[df.has_TM].detector_n, df[~df.has_TM].detector_n], bins=bins, stacked=True,
       color=["#1b6ca8", "#bbbbbb"], label=["transition metal in file (n=%d)" % df.has_TM.sum(),
                                            "no transition metal (n=%d)" % (~df.has_TM).sum()])
a.axvline(0, color="#c23b22", lw=2.5)
a.annotate("bll6423 model = 0\n3ES1 (38% id) = 0", xy=(0, 11), xytext=(2.2, 16),
           arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#c23b22"), color="#c23b22", fontsize=9)
a.set_xlabel("largest ligand cluster found (residues)"); a.set_ylabel("cupin chains")
a.set_title("88 experimentally determined cupin chains\n%d of %d (%.0f%%) have a detectable site"
            % (n_hit, n_tot, 100*n_hit/n_tot), fontsize=10)
a.legend(fontsize=8, frameon=False)

a = ax[1]
vals = [47/48*100, 12/40*100, 1/48*100]
labs = ["sensitivity\n47/48 metal-bound\ndetected", "specificity\n12/40 metal-free\nsilent",
        "false negative\n1/48"]
a.bar(labs, vals, color=["#1b6ca8", "#888", "#c23b22"])
for i, v in enumerate(vals): a.text(i, v+2, f"{v:.0f}%", ha="center", fontsize=9)
a.set_ylim(0, 112); a.set_ylabel("percent")
a.set_title("Detector performance on cupins\nodds ratio 20.1, Fisher exact p = 3.9e-4", fontsize=10)
a.text(0.5, 60, "low specificity is expected:\nmost metal-free cupin files\nare apo forms that keep\ntheir site",
       fontsize=8, ha="center", style="italic", color="#444")

a = ax[2]
h = df[df.has_TM & df.detector_hit].dist_cluster_to_metal.dropna()
a.hist(h, bins=np.arange(0, 8.5, 0.5), color="#1b6ca8")
a.axvline(2.0, color="k", ls="--", lw=1)
a.text(2.1, a.get_ylim()[1]*0.8, "%d of %d within 2.0 A" % ((h < 2).sum(), len(h)), fontsize=8)
a.set_xlabel("cluster centroid to nearest metal (A)"); a.set_ylabel("structures")
a.set_title("The clusters are the real metal sites\nmedian offset %.2f A" % h.median(), fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
